intro: Chet tilidan yozma ish topshiriqlari nomzodning til bilimini kompleks baholashga qaratilgan. Ushbu topshiriqlar orqali quyidagi ko‘nikmalar aniqlanadi:

parts.title: 1-bo‘lim: Elektron xatlar
parts.lead: Nomzod bitta vaziyat asosida ikki xil elektron xat (email) yozadi.

tasks.name: Task 1.1 · Norasmiy xat (do‘stga)
tasks.aim: shaxsiy fikr, hissiyot va rejalarni bildirish

tasks.name: Task 1.2 · Rasmiy xat (tashkilot yoki rahbariyatga)
tasks.aim: muammo, taklif, shikoyat yoki so‘rov bildirish

parts.note: Nomzod bir xil vaziyatni ikki xil uslubda ifodalay olishi kerak. Bu uning tilni real hayotiy vaziyatlarda samarali qo‘llay olish qobiliyatini ko‘rsatadi.

parts.title: 2-bo‘lim: Blog posti yoki maqola
parts.lead: Nomzod umumiy qiziqish uyg‘otadigan mavzu asosida ijodiy-tahliliy matn yozadi.

tasks.name: Part 2 · Blog posti / maqola / muhokama posti

summary: Yozma ish topshiriqlari — bu faqat grammatik test emas, balki nomzodning fikrlash darajasi, kommunikativ qobiliyati va tilni real vaziyatda qo‘llash ko‘nikmasini aniqlashga xizmat qiluvchi muhim baholash vositasidir.

tasks.text:
Hi Ben,
Did you hear the club is closing for a month? I'm really disappointed—we’ll miss our workouts! I think they should offer online classes or outdoor group sessions during the break. Also, it’d be great if they improve the showers and maybe add more space in the stretching area.
Take care,
Nico
tasks.comment: The response is beyond level B1.

tasks.text:
Dear Manager,

Thank you for your email. Even I understand that the building needs some repairs and new equipment, I was a bit disappointed to hear that the fitness club will be closed for one month. I usually come a few times a week, so it’s an important part of my lifestyle.

I would like to suggest some improvements. The changing rooms are sometimes too small and not very clean, so maybe they can be repaired. It would be also nice to have more fitness classes in the evenings when most people can come.
Thank you for listening to our opinions. I hope to return to club soon.
Best regards,
Nicolas Tedros.

Vocabulary is sufficient to discuss the topics. Errors in grammar, and word choice do not cause misunderstanding. Some cohesive devices and referencing are used to connect sentences.

tasks.text:
I think living in a small town is better than living in a big city, even if both have some advantages. In my opinion, small towns are more calm and people can live there with less stress. There is not so much noise and traffic like in big cities, so it’s easier to relax and enjoy free time. Also, the air is more clean and the nature is closer, which is good for health.

Another reason is that people in small towns usually know each other and are more friendly. There is a stronger feeling of community, and it’s easier to make friends. For example, in my town I often meet people I know when I go outside.

Of course, big cities offer more job opportunities and better education. You can find more shops, cinemas, and restaurants there. But I think life in a city can be very fast and tired. It’s not easy to find a silent place or to have time for yourself.

In conclusion, I prefer to living in a small town because the life is easier and more peaceful. I know that some people choose big cities, but for me, small town gives better quality of life.
